name: Sam's Club Distribution Center Hattiesburg MS

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open, uncontrolled driveway. Street View (pano KRg-ik6V6TZ3JfxYJHcDQw, Feb 2025) at the entrance throat shows a paved drive curving in from J M Tatum Industrial Dr with only a property/directional sign on a post — no barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or pinch-point checkpoint. No perimeter fence; the lot is bounded by an open grassy buffer and woods.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the entrance. The row of small white rectangular structures visible on the inner perimeter (z20/z21) are evenly-spaced utility/storage sheds along the yard edge, not a 1-3-stall guard booth set beside a gate lane.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Gate-to-dock approach crosses a ~300m+ open buffer plus an internal access loop; easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors run on BOTH the north and south long faces, but this is a single continuous cross-dock operation (Saddle Creek consolidation/cross-dock for Sam's Club), not two physically distinct ship vs receive clusters. Marked false; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimate ~64 total (~32 per long face on a ~137m building at ~4m door spacing, doors on both faces). Honest overhead estimate; band 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple dedicated long trailer-storage rows north and south of the building, separate from the dock aprons; clearly 50+ stalls.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~160 trailers counted across the captured imagery (rows N, S, E of the building). Approximate.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: ~200 based on the marked-row footprint of the drop yards plus dock aprons. Approximate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park beside Hattiesburg-Bobby L. Chain Municipal Airport, surrounded by woods and farmland. Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Industrial park with neighboring DCs and a town nearby; cellular coverage likely adequate. Marked false but low-confidence.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh platform visible in the truck path.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 10.5 ac derived from the perimeter polygon (cleared/paved operating lot inside the tree line).
fieldNotes.facilityConfirmation: Confirmed via address (185 J M Tatum Industrial Dr) and web (Saddle Creek-operated Sam's Club DC #4792). Long cross-dock building with trailers backed in on both faces and surrounding drop-yard rows is unmistakably the DC, not the office listing (45k sqft listing is the registration footprint).
